name: Weekly Ladder
prompt: Every week, move 5% of the treasury pool into a prize pool and pay the top three on the leaderboard 50%, 30% and 20% of it.

pools.about: 5% of the treasury each week, paid to the top three.

decisions.when: the week ends: first place on the leaderboard
the week ends: second place, paid right after first
decisions.to: second place (60% of what is left is 30% of the week's prize)

decisions.when: the week ends: third place, paid right after second
